bank.retain_mission: Extract curated design system tokens (colors, font families, spacing standards), brand visual rules, responsive layout guidelines, and accessibility constraints. Ignore raw HTML DOM trees, accessibility node dumps, and transient CSS snippets (which openadapt inspects live).
bank.observations_mission: Track design system token evolution, brand visual guidelines, and UI feedback constraints over time.
bank.reflect_mission: Synthesize a visual design specification detailing curated design tokens, color standards, typography rules, and accessibility constraints.

mental_models.name: Design System Tokens & Brand Standards
mental_models.source_query: What are the project's curated design system tokens, color palettes, typography standards, spacing units, and brand visual guidelines?

mental_models.name: Responsive Layout & Accessibility Constraints
mental_models.source_query: What are the responsive breakpoint rules, grid layout guidelines, dark mode preferences, and accessibility constraints?
